answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 21647 Country: SG Title: its is well known that angels do not enter a house with pictures. what about id cards? they also have pictures on it. so will angels enter the house? Question: its is well known that angels do not enter a house with pictures. what about id cards? they also have pictures on it. so will angels enter the house? Answer ID: 21647 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 728/507/L=1431) Identity card is made in need and compulsion. This does not prevent angels from entering the house. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
